stop_reason: GSE331495 holds only bulk RNA-seq of cultured primary dermal fibroblasts (4 young, 5 older donors) and induced neurons (8 young, 5 older) from the SHOCK healthy-aging cohort (DA.p1, S4.6.p1-p2). Its only factors are donor age group and sex; there is no exercise, training, or pre/post intervention sample. The paper's exercise result (12-week mild exercise in 5 STRONG participants) is PBMC autophagy flux measured by LC3B-II Western blot (S2.5.p1-p3, S4.2.p1, S4.11.p1) and was not sequenced, so the data cannot identify how exercise affects gene expression.
